summary: Master pricing strategy and revenue management with dashboards, elasticity analysis, and dynamic pricing. Learn practical tools for better margin control.
lede: Pricing strategy and revenue management helps professionals in pricing, revenue, sales, finance, and commercial planning make structured pricing decisions. They learn to assess price sensitivity and competitor pricing, build segment-based pricing models and discount guardrails, and use demand forecasts and scenario planning to guide revenue decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is built for you if you already work with pricing, revenue, sales, finance, or commercial planning and need a stronger operating method. Pricing Analysts who monitor price performance and competitor moves. Revenue Managers who balance demand, yield, and margin. Commercial Managers who set pricing rules across segments and channels. Sales Managers who manage discount requests and approval discipline. Finance Business Partners who assess margin impact and revenue forecasts. Category Managers who shape product price architecture and promotions. Revenue Optimization Specialists who run pacing and yield reviews. Commercial Analysts who build pricing dashboards and scenario models. Product Managers who influence packaging and value-based pricing. Operations Managers who support pricing execution across service capacity.
modules: Pricing Strategy and Revenue Management Foundations
Pricing Model Design with Value-Based Pricing
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, basic spreadsheet skills, and familiarity with pricing, sales, or revenue reporting. If available, bring a recent price list, promotion report, sales extract, or revenue summary for workshop use.
